1. Select the *gear icon* on any deck

3. Verify which settings profile you are using (I use default and apply it to all my decks)

6. FSRS is now enabled, and Anki will learn from your review history. To train your AI model, return to this screen and hit Optimize Presets.

Go to Brightspace and find the lecture
Find the "Anki" module and click download
Once it finishes downloading, click on the file
You can also click on the file in your downloads folder
Anki will open it, and hit "import"
Next click "show" to select all the newly imported cards
Press CTRL or CMD + A to select all the cards
Right click, and select "Change Deck"
Select your deck, or click "Add" to create a new one
Close the browser to see your cards
On your computer, Find & Click on the downloaded *Anking.apkg* file
Anki will open it in "Import Mode", then click the *Import Button*
*Wait* for Anki to import Anking (Will take minutes, ~42,000 cards!)
When Overview screen is seen, close out the dialog
Anking cards have been imported, but need to be *suspended* to be organized. Click Browse.
On the left, find *Decks* in the tag tree, then click on *Anking*
Select All The Cards (CTRL or CMD + A)
Right Click, and *Toggle Suspend*
Close out the Browser
Now your cards are *Suspended*, click the minus by Anking to collapse the tree

stops.text: From your third party resource (ex: B&B Bile), go to Anki
Click Browse
On the left, scroll down in the Tag Tree, until you reach *Tags*
Click on the *Step_1_v12* tag
Find your resource tag (ex: B&B for Boards & Beyond)
Click through to your chapter/section (ex: GI > GI_Physiology)
Click on your video/resource (Ex: Bile)
Notice 30 cards were found for this resource, but are currently suspended (in yellow color, archived)
You can click through and preview the cards that it found you can choose to unsuspend
I will select all of them (CTRL + A), and unsuspend them
Right Click, and click *Toggle Suspend*
Study your cards in the Anking deck (ex: 30 cards)

pages.name: Find Anking cards by Copied Tag
pages.sidebarTitle: Find Anking cards by Copied Tag
pages.breadcrumb: Find Anking cards by Copied Tag

stops.text: Most third party resources (ex: Bile, Boards and Beyond) have been directly tagged in Anking
If you know the direct tag string, copy it and return to anki
Click Browse
*Paste* the tag string into the search bar & press *Enter*
Review the found cards (ex: 30), and select all (CTRL + A)
Right click, and click *Toggle Suspend*
Close the browser
Study the cards within the Anking Deck (ex: 30)
Navigate to the row corresponding to your lecture
Copy the "Specific Anking Tags" string
Return to Anki and click *Browse*
Paste in the copied text into the search bar, and hit *Enter*
Review the found cards, and click through them to preview them (ex: 75 cards)
Select the cards you want, I will select all with (CTRL + A)
Right click, and hit *Toggle Suspend*
Close the browser
Study the cards in the Anking Deck (ex: 75 cards)
Find a set of cards (ex: by tag, spreadsheet, or tag tree)
Notice by default, 75 cards were selected
Find the *High Yield* tag, and copy it
Paste it AFTER the tag within the search query with a *space*
Press *enter*
Notice only 25 cards now appear, that all have the High Yield Tag
Review the cards, and select them, I select all with CTRL + A
Right Click, and Click *Toggle Suspend*
Close the browser
Review the cards in the Anking Deck (ex: 25 cards)
If you want Anking cards from an Amboss question, click "Get Anki Cards"
Review the suggested cards, and uncheck if not needed - then click "Copy Anki query"
Navigate back to Anki and hit Browse
Paste the copied query into the search bar, and press enter
Review the cards, and select the ones you want to unsuspend (I selected all with CTRL + A)
Right click, and select "Toggle Suspend"
Close the browser, and now your cards are ready to study
After finding a question you want Anking cards for, find the "Question id:" box
Select and copy the *Question Id* (ex: 3110)
Return back to Anki, and hit *Browse*
Inside the search bar, type in tag:\*UWorld\*: followed by the question id, ex: tag:\*UWorld\*:3110; then hit *Enter* to search
These are the cards found for this particular question (ex: uWorld question #3110 has 2 Anking Cards)
Select the cards (CTRL + A to select All), and right click
Select "Toggle Suspend"
Close the Browser to review the cards
Instead of manually searching by *Question Id* (ex: 3110), you can search for an addon *"Find cards from UWorld test "*
Scroll down to find the Addon Code
Copy the addon code
Return to Anki, and press *Tools > Add-ons*
Click *Get Add-ons*
Paste in the code you copied, and click ok
Anki has installed the Addon, Click Ok
Notice that "Tools" does NOT have the new button - you have to *RESTART* Anki to finish installing the addon
Now click tools
Click *find cards from UWorld test*
Paste in a question id, or list of question ids (ex: 3110, 9810)
These are the cards associated with those question(s). You can unsuspend them by Right Click > *Toggle Suspend*

stops.text: Finish your UWorld question set to get to the *review screen*
Find and click *Question List*
*Copy* the displayed Question Ids
Click *Tools*
Click *Find cards from uWorld Test* (you must have the addon installed)
*Paste* in the copied question ids
These are the cards tagged to this question id list, you can now review which cards you want to unsuspend! (Right click > Toggle Suspend)
Click *Browse*
Copy the specified tag (Step 1 cards that DO NOT also have Step 2 tagged)
Paste it into the search bar, and hit *Enter*
Select all the cards (CTRL + A)
Click *Toggle Suspend*
Close the browser

stops.text: Click *Browse*
On the left, scroll down to the tag *AK_Step2_v12*
Click on the tag *!Shelf*
Select your rotation (ex: *Peds*)
Select the *no_dupes* tag to avoid duplicate cards (ex: 1377 cards) - these cards will include helpful Step 1 cards
Click only_step2 if you want strictly clerkship level cards (ex: 644 cards)
Review which cards you want to unsuspend (ex: 644 cards in a 32 day clerkship = 20 cards per day), and *select those cards*
Right click, *Toggle Suspend* to add them into your live rotation
Close the browser
Study the cards in the Anking deck
